high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from Wikipedia, specifically the English version (en.m.wikipedia.org). The content discusses George Santayana, a philosopher known for his aphorisms and cultural critiques. The text highlights his philosophical contributions, including famous quotes like "Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it" and "Only the dead have seen the end of war." It also mentions his definition of beauty as "Pleasure objectified." The text notes that despite being an atheist, Santayana valued Spanish Catholic culture and values.
